## 03 – Metrics Analysis (owner: Tharindu)
Current vs baseline for cpu, memory (prom-client defaults) and error_rate / latency_p95 / request_rate (only when `PROM_QUERY_*` is set).
Abnormal = above `PROM_THRESHOLD_*` or ≥ `PROM_ANOMALY_FACTOR` × baseline.
